warnings: Slab sections are detail views (spans written as L, L/3, L/4); thicknesses and bar callouts are member-internal and stay on the elements.

S2 is printed twice under the same title 'S2(ด้านสั้น)' — the right-hand view is evidently the long direction (S1 shows ด้านสั้น / ด้านยาว in the same layout). Both views carry identical bars, so nothing depends on which is which; flagged on S2.
